title: Reusable score processor artifact consumers deploy pinned images
description:
As a platform operator, I want reusable score processor artifacts to be published and consumed by immutable reference, so that deployments can promote and roll back score processor versions deterministically.

Feature: Immutable score processor deployment artifacts

Scenario: External infrastructure deploys a pinned score processor image
Given a score processor image has been built from a known Plexus source revision
When downstream infrastructure requests the image by immutable tag or digest
Then the deployed score processor version is deterministic and does not depend on mutable latest tags

Scenario: Plexus remains independent of downstream deployments
Given a downstream infrastructure owner consumes Plexus score processor artifacts
When Plexus publishes or documents the artifact contract
Then Plexus does not require downstream account IDs, pipeline names, secret paths, or environment-specific deployment configuration

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Superseded as written by the release-owned build model. Deterministic downstream deployment is now achieved by building from the immutable Plexus package revision in the integration pipeline, rather than consuming a Plexus-published image. Re-scope or close this story after the package-resource contract is confirmed.
